name: OpenHands Enterprise
desc: Control plane for who may run agents and what they touch.
desc_zh: 决定谁能跑智能体、能碰什么的控制平面。
solves: Agent use spreads without anyone knowing what is running; this gives platform and security teams one place to set limits and watch spend.
solves_zh: 智能体用得越来越广，却没人说得清在跑什么；这里让平台和安全团队在一处设定边界并看清花费。
best_for: Your company wants agents everywhere but the security team has not approved anything yet.
best_for_zh: 公司想到处用智能体，而安全团队还没批准任何一项。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — openhands.dev/blog directory）。 Announced as the Agent Control Plane; runs in your own environment. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.openhands.dev/blog/openhands-enterprise-agent-control-plane
